_comment: Owner-supplied Great Lakes dune references guide broad sand crests, sparse exposed areas and grass-framed sandy paths. Native-reviewed production dune cover; no reference pixels or new models are shipped. Veilfall's static mountain vegetation and authored groves retain their own treatment.
_comment_colonies: Twelve pointed leaves with four wider basal blades and four grouped stem bases form beach grass colonies. Broad bare gaps and sparse pioneers keep sandy passages visible.

ground_cover._comment_colony_shape: Coverage: independently warped bare gaps cut whole colonies; sparse pioneers soften their margins and extend only onto dry painted shore. The zero-shift colony recipe retains the existing colony ramp at low elevation while removing its coastal probability ceiling. Sparse pioneers retain the coastal probability ceiling. The same 1-3m dry-height fade applies to all eligible ground, avoiding a shore/grass paint-density edge; forbidden-ground and clearance rules remain unchanged. Rock, wet-height, holes and all existing built/anchor/camp clearances remain enforced. Physical shore grading is baked separately; this cover recipe does not change terrain/control maps. The separate dune_tuft_shape recipe changes only the grass mesh and tuft count.

shelter._comment: Canopy and understory share deterministic centres accepted by both original ground/slope/clearance rules. Existing lee bounds remain unchanged. An upwind ridge must rise at least ridge_relief_m above the centre; bounded unsuccessful searches report zero groves with no fallback placement.
